name: Luminants
desc:
**Luminants** are described to be certain regions of the world of Deepwoken.

There are currently two Luminants in the game, which are the Etrean and Eastern Luminants respectively.

It is known the world was once five continental landmasses, though the rising tides due to The Submergence have turned it into the 6 Luminants known today.

Luminants are shaped as gatherings of islands over their own Sea, which are differentiated from the Void-sea. Luminants seem to have three big wave shaped islands (the cause of this wavy form is unknown) with smaller islands around; known exceptions to this are the Central Luminant, which is one giant island and an archipelago, and the Southern Luminant, which is mostly sunk and hence has lost most of its islands, including its three major ones.
